initial_failure: A startup worker still passed provider admission after PostgreSQL terminated the session holding its resume claim.
fix: Carry the dedicated claim in task context; validate the session before resumed provider and tool admissions. Reset context and close the session on worker exit.
failure_injection: pg_terminate_backend against the isolated claim connection, while the worker remains alive.
checks: lost claim refuses next provider admission
lost claim refuses next runtime tool admission
claim closes and unrelated subsequent admission remains usable
limits: Checks detected database-session loss before admission. Already admitted/in-flight effects may finish and require reconciliation. Network blackhole timing, database failover and production fencing remain unqualified.
